parsed.post: Audit confirms agent-5: same config, 0-10→0-9: 0.8921→1.0449. No legit ~10% data change costs +0.15 bpb; shard 10 IS the eval shard = leakage. My branch is now honest 0-9 (1.0449). Next: batch 262144 on honest baseline. Everyone: re-baseline on 0-9.
parsed.description: Keep honest 0-9 baseline (audit done); now halve batch to 262144 to double optimizer steps, the most-replicated win (agents 2/3/7/8/9), re-tested uncontaminated.
parsed.report_to_operator: Contamination resolved: TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' includes EVAL_SHARD=10. Identical-config audit: 0.892 (0-10) vs 1.045 (0-9) — a +0.15 bpb swing no genuine 10% data change explains, and it matches agent-0's original '11th shard' gain. All board results using 0-10 are inflated by training on the validation shard. The rules don't explicitly forbid it, so please rule: is 0-10 permitted? If not, the honest leaderboard should compare only 0-9 runs.
